read.thesis: Lennar traded volume for margin: Q3 gross margin 15.8% on 12% incentives, FY deliveries cut to 80,000-81,000, and Q4 margin guided 15.5-16.0% as land basis still washes through.

triggers.label: FY deliveries cut to 80,000-81,000
triggers.quote: Revised Full-Year Deliveries Guidance -- 80,000 to 81,000 units, lowered from the previous target of 82,000 to 83,000 units
triggers.highlight: lowered from the previous target of 82,000 to 83,000 units

triggers.label: Incentives ~12% of ASP
triggers.quote: Average Sales Price -- $372,000, reflecting approximately 12% in sales incentives to maintain volume

triggers.label: Orders down 9% YoY
triggers.quote: 20,840 deliveries and 20,879 new orders, reflecting 3% and 9% decreases, respectively

triggers.label: Finished inventory 2.1 → 1.8 per community
triggers.quote: completed unsold inventory came down again to 1.8 homes per community from 2.1 last quarter
triggers.highlight: came down again to 1.8 homes per community

triggers.label: Cycle time 116 days, record low
triggers.quote: Construction Cycle Time -- 116 days, marking a record low

guidance.quote: Revised Full-Year Deliveries Guidance -- 80,000 to 81,000 units, lowered from the previous target of 82,000 to 83,000 units
we expect to generate new orders of approximately 19,500 to 20,500 and to deliver 22,000 to 23,000 homes
Our gross margins should be in the range of 15.5% to 16%
these estimates should produce an EPS range of approximately $1.30 to $1.65 for the fourth quarter

prior_guidance_check.quote: lowered from the previous target of 82,000 to 83,000 units
Gross margin was 15.8%, up from 15.6% last quarter and just below the approximately 16% we guided to.
SG&A was 9.2%, above our expected range of 8.8% to 9%.

red_flags.label: Margin sacrificed for volume
red_flags.quote: That means we are compromising margin in order to maintain volume.

red_flags.label: Land basis drag persists
red_flags.quote: The land headwind is still in front of us for a while, but it is finite, it is visible

red_flags.label: Option maintenance fees rising from paused takedowns
red_flags.quote: our option maintenance fees are accumulating for longer periods of time because we have moderated our growth

red_flags.label: Q3 orders and SG&A missed guidance
red_flags.quote: We missed this quarter. It didn't feel good.

evasions.quote: I really don't want to make a prediction at this point given the volatility of the market.
it is a hard question to answer, and I'll tell you why.
So I don't have an answer on the percentage where we have paused.
